propositions: A maintained Python client (pycontribs/jira) must back the DC transport behind an opt-in extra, with lazy import so rebar remains dependency-free
Personal Access Token authentication via JIRA_PAT env var and bearer token must be implemented; malformed config must raise ConfigError rather than degrade

All TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, and SupportsAbsenceProbe methods must return unwrapped raw payload shapes, not jira.Issue objects, held to the shared _jira_shape_contract assertions
TLS validation must reject non-https base_url unless allow_insecure=true; certificate verification must never be disabled; ca_bundle must configure internal CAs
The DC backend must self-register in _backend_registry via an import statement in adapters/__init__.py so select_backend('jira-datacenter') resolves at runtime

Live tests against the J5 harness must cover all transport methods end-to-end and assert postconditions on the real server; NameIdentity user-search must return authoritative identity for real users and raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError for unknown ones
